accountConnect.account: Ka fara o kan, baara kɛbagaw tun tɛ dugu kɔnɔ, u tun tɛ baara kɛ ni naani ye. I ka kan ka sɛbɛri kɛ ka sɔrɔ ka sɛbɛri kɛ.
accountConnect.body: I ka kɔnti siri walasa ka i ka profil mara, ka posti kɛ ani ka kɔntɛnu kɛ chat kɔnɔ. Siriliw bɛ ban tile 24 kɔnɔ. I bɛ se ka a filɛ i bɛ min kɛ tuma o tuma.

accountConnect.generate: Media kɛ ni i ka krɛdiw, sɔrɔ minnu bɛ kɛ, walima imaji minnu bɛ sɔrɔ fɛn tɛ
accountConnect.generatePrompt: DeHub ka ɲɛyiraliw yira n' na ani ka ɲɛyirali dɔ yira n' na sanni n' k'u dilan.
accountConnect.intro: DeHub kalan ChatGPT kɔnɔ, walima i yɛrɛ ka kɔnti siri walasa ka i ka profil yɛlɛma, ka posti kɛ ani ka Kɔntɛnu Studio kɛ. A https://dehub.io/mcp kɛ OAuth sirila kɔnti mara fɛnw kosɔn.
accountConnect.libraryPrompt: N' ka gafew be sɔrɔ n' ka gafew kɔnɔ.
accountConnect.profile: I ka profil, imajiw ani siraba kɔnɔna yɛlɛma
accountConnect.read: I ka kɔnti, posti, notifikasɔnw ani Kɔntɛnu kɛla ka bibliyotɛki kalan
accountConnect.social: Posti ani kɔmentɛri kɛ, mɔgɔw tugu ani bukmarkw mara
accountConnect.step: N'i b'a fɛ ka kunnafoniw mara, i ka https://dehub.io/mcp fara a kan i n'a fɔ OAuth, ka don DeHub la ani ka sɔnni lajɛ sanni i ka se ka don.
accountConnect.title: I ka DeHub kɔnti siri
accountConnect.what: Posti ani profil minnu bɛ kɛnɛ kan, olu kalan. Ni OAuth kɔnti sirili bɛ, i bɛ se ka i ka profil ani siraba mara, ka posti ani kɔmentɛri kɛ, ka mɔgɔw tugu, ka notifikasɔnw kalan, ka bukmarkw mara ani ka imaji, videwo, odiyo ani 3D fɛnw kɛ. Kɛli bɛ DeHub ka sɔrɔ kɛli sariya kɔrɔw kɛ.

careers.title: Baara DeHub la
careers.subtitle: Don jɛkulu la min bɛ social media min tɛ sigi yɔrɔ kelen na, o siniko jɔ
careers.intro: An bɛ mɔgɔ ɲɛnamaw ɲini minnu b'a fɛ ka kɛ social media kɔrɔ kura dɔ ye — min bɛ dabalibagaw ni jɛkuluw bila fɔlɔ. Baara bɛɛ bɛ kɛ yɔrɔjan na ni waati nɔgɔyalenw ye.
careers.negotiableSalaryOTE: Sara min bɛ se ka sɔsɔ + OTE Komisɔn
careers.bdmAbout: I kɛlen DeHub ka Jago Yiriwali Ɲɛmɔgɔ dɔ ye, i bɛna kɛ an ka jɛɲɔgɔnya fɛɛrɛ fanga dɔ ye. I ka baara ye ka sosiyetew ɲini, ka kuma u fɛ, ka bɛnkanw kɛ u fɛ Web2 ni Web3 kɔnɔ — ka bɔ tulonkɛ studiow ni fɛn platformw la ka se blockchain porozɛw ni DeFi protocolw ma. Nin ye OTE (On-Target Earnings) komisɔn baara ye: ni i ye baara kɛ kosɛbɛ, i bɛ wari caman sɔrɔ. Baara ka nɔgɔn, sosiyetew, porozɛw, jɛkuluw walima konti belebelebaw lana DeHub kan, ka i sara sɔrɔ.
careers.bdmResp1: Jɛɲɔgɔnya nafamaw ɲini ka u sabati ni Web2 ni Web3 sosiyetew ye minnu bɛ bɛn DeHub ka laɲini ma
careers.bdmResp2: Jɛɲɔgɔn, dɛmɛbaga ani ɲɔgɔn fara sababu nataw lisi jɔ k'a ɲɛminɛ
careers.bdmResp3: DeHub jira baarakɛyɔrɔ ɲɔgɔnyew, konferansiw ani ɲɔgɔnye internɛti kanw na
careers.bdmResp4: Jɛɲɔgɔnya sariyaw, tɔnɔ tilali cogoyaw ani jago ɲɔgɔn fɛ bɛnkanw sɔsɔ
careers.bdmResp5: Baara kɛ ni porodui ni jago jɛkuluw ye ka kanpaɲi ni ɲɔgɔn fara baaraw labɛn ɲɔgɔn fɛ
careers.bdmReq1: Dɔnniya jiralen jago yiriwali, jɛɲɔgɔnyaw walima feereli la tekinoloji, tulonkɛ walima Web3 kɔnɔ
careers.bdmReq2: Ni i ka jɛkulu barikama bɛ crypto/Web3 walima dabalibagaw ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔ, o ye nafa belebeleba ye
careers.bdmReq3: Kumakan ni sɔsɔli seko ɲuman — i bɛ se ka bɛnkanw kɛ ani ka jɛɲɔgɔnya mɛnnenw jɔ
careers.bdmReq4: I yɛrɛ bɛ i yɛrɛ lawuli ani i bɛ se ka baara kɛ i kelen na yɔrɔjan na
careers.bdmReq5: I bɛ social media min tɛ sigi yɔrɔ kelen na, NFTw walima blockchain tekinoloji diyanye tiɲɛ na
careers.bdmComp: Nin baara bɛ sara jusigilan di min bɛ se ka sɔsɔ, ani OTE komisɔn sigicogo dan tɛ min na, min bɛ tali kɛ i bɛ jɛɲɔgɔnya minnu lana. Baarakɛla ɲumanbaw ka wari sɔrɔli dan tɛ.

careers.ambassadorAbout: I mana kɛ DeHub Tɔgɔla ye, i ye platform ɲɛda ni a kan ye i ka jɛkulu kɔnɔ. I ka baara ye ka DeHub kibaro jɛnsɛn sira bɛɛ fɛ i bɛ min na — social media, ɲɔgɔnye sɛbɛw, gaming ɲɛnajɛw, inivɛrisite dugukolow, ani fɔ ka taa a fɛ. Nin ye baara ye min sara bɛ sara kalo o kalo, a tɛ komisiyɔn kan; i bɛna sɔrɔ sabatilen sɔrɔ ka bonya ni platform ye ɲɔgɔn fɛ.

raffle.fairnessTitle: Mun na an be se ka la a la ko an bena se k'o kɛ?
raffle.fairnessBody: O la, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni mɔgɔ dɔ ye min be se ka dɔ fara a ka baara kan. Koo saba b'a to o be kɛ tiɲɛn ye.

raffle.fair1Body: O la, u bena a yira ko u ye mɔgɔ dɔw ye minw ye mɔgɔ dɔw ye. O kɔ, an tɛ se ka foyi fara o kan.
raffle.fair2Title: O la, a tun be se ka kɛ ko a tun ye mɔgɔ dɔ ye min tun be se
raffle.fair2Body: O la, mɔgɔ min be se k'a latigɛ a bena min kɛ, o tigi ka kan ka kɛ mɔgɔ ye min be baara kɛ ni jama ye, a kana kɛ mɔgɔ ye min be baara kɛ ni mɔgɔ ye.
raffle.fair3Title: O kama, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni miiriya ɲuman ye.
raffle.fair3Body: O la, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni sɛbɛri ye min be se k'a dɛmɛ ka baara kɛ ni sɛbɛri ye. O la, mɔgɔ minw be kunnafoniw sɔrɔ, olu ka kan ka se ka mɔgɔ kelen sɔrɔ.
raffle.neverPayTitle: DeHub tɛna i deli i ka wari di walisa ka sara dɔ bɔ
raffle.neverPayBody: Mɔgɔ minw ye ɲɔgɔndanw sɔrɔ, u tɔgɔw be sɔrɔ o yɔrɔ la ani u be sɔrɔ o yɔrɔ la. DeHub ka mɔgɔ si tɛna i weele ka na i ka wari, i ka kisɛ, i ka jɔnjɔn wala i ka wari di i ma walisa k'i ka sara di i ma. Mɔgɔ min be kuma, o tigi ka kan ka kɛ mɔgɔ ye. A y'a sɛbɛ ko: "An ka ɲi ka banba k'a fɔ ko an ka ɲi ka banba k'a fɔ".
raffle.faqBody: An be minw ɲininga tuma caaman na, u be minw weele ka na an ka soo, an be minw weele ka na an ka soo ani an be minw sara.
raffle.faq1Q: Yala ne ka kan ka fɛɛn dɔ san walisa ka don DeHub ka sara la wa?
raffle.faqPurchaseAnswer: O la, mɔgɔ minw be se ka don o yɔrɔ la, olu ka kan ka don o yɔrɔ la. O kama, a tun man nɔgɔ ka wari caaman sɔrɔ.
raffle.faq2Q: N' be se k'a lɔn cogo di ko a ma sigi sen kan?
raffle.faq2A: O la, a ka kan ka kɛ ni sɛbɛri ye min be sɔrɔ a ka sɛbɛri kɔnɔ. O la, mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ be se k'o kɛ, a be se k'o kɛ.
raffle.faq3A: O kama, a ka ɲi ka tɛmɛ fɛɛrɛ dɔw fɛ k'a yira ko a ka di mɔgɔ ye ka baara kɛ n'a ye. O kama, i tɛ se ka e-mail ci ka wari sara, ka wari sɔrɔ wala ka wari sɔrɔ. DeHub tɛna mɔgɔ si deli a ka sara di a ma.
raffle.faq4Q: Ne bena o fɔ aw ye fɔɔ tuma jumɛn?
raffle.faq4A: O kama, a ka ɲi ka to ka kuma ni mɔgɔ wɛrɛw ye. O kama, a tun ka di a ye ka wari di a ma. O la, an be se ka taga yɔrɔ min na, an be se ka taga yen.
raffle.faq5Q: Jɔn lo be se ka kɛ o tigi ye?
raffle.faq5A: Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ be ni DeHub ka ladɛrɛsi ye min ka kan ka tɛmɛ saan 18 kan ani a be yɔrɔ dɔ la min ka kan ka kɛ a ka ladɛrɛsi ye, o tigi ka kan ka kɛ o tigi ye. DeHub ka baarakɛlaw, u ka baarakɛlaw ani u ka soow tɛ se ka baara kɛ.
raffle.faq6Q: U bele be sanfɛla la fɔɔ tuma jumɛn?
raffle.faq6A: A tun tɛ labɛnna. O ye ka mɔgɔ bila sira ka baara kɛ n'a ye, ka baara kɛ n'a ye ani ka baara kɛ n'a ye.
raffle.ctaTitle: O kɔ, a ye dɔ fara a ka fanga kan.
raffle.ctaBody: Koo o koo be yen sisan, u b'o fɔ i ka dumuni na. I ka kunnafoniw bila walisa mɔgɔ wɛrɛ kana tɛmɛ i fɛ.

walletSetup.enterRecoveryPhrase: Laseginni kuma daɲɛ 12 sɛbɛn, i ye min mara tuma min na i ye nin wari maralan dilan (walima a konnɛgɛ gundo, n'i y'a labɔ). A bɛ segin jate kelen kan, ani tɛmɛsira min b'i sigi duguma, o bɛ kɛ nɔɲɔgɔnna ye min bɛ baara kɛ yɔrɔ bɛɛ kabini sisan.

walletSetup.legacyRecovered: An y'i ka jate kɔrɔ{{suffix}} sɛgɛsɛgɛ ani k'a ka wari maraso sɔrɔ. Tɔgɔ gundolen sigi walisa k'a lakana nin minan kan — nin telefɔni kan ani yɔrɔ bɛɛ, ka bɔ sisan.

walletSetup.deviceCheckCancelled: Minɛn lajɛli dabilara — foyi ma yɛlɛma.
walletSetup.walletLeftBehind: Wari maralan min bɛ to kɔ: {{address}}
walletSetup.biometricKeepsFailing: {{error}} Ni nin ma se tuguni, i ka wari maralan tɛmɛsira kɛ duguma walima "Kilew don".
walletSetup.deviceBoundKey: Nin wari maralan bɛ da wuli ni bolonɔ ye min maralen bɛ minɛn kelen dɔrɔn kan — telefɔni walima navigatɛri min kan a sigira. O konnɛgɛ tɛ nin telefɔni bolo, dehub.io fana t'a bolo: konnɛgɛ tɛ bɔ abada minɛn na min y'a dilan.
walletSetup.unlockPasskeyOnly: Nin wari maralan lakananna ni passkey ye web kan ani tɛmɛsira maracogo si t'a la nuwaji la fɔlɔ. N'i ye wari maralan tɛmɛsira dɔ sigi dehub.io kan, a sɛbɛn yan — n'o tɛ, "Kilew don" kɛ duguma.
walletSetup.unlockWithPasswordExplainer: Wari maralan dɔ bɛ nin jate bolo kaban, tɛmɛsira b'a lakana. A sɛbɛn walasa ka i ka wari maralan lasegin nin minɛn kan.
walletSetup.recoveryRecordNotice: Laseginni sɛbɛn dɔ bɛ nin jate bolo dehub.io kan. Laseginni kode daɲɛ 24 min dira i ma, o bɛ se ka nin wari maralan da wuli halibi. dehub.io da wuli ɔridinatɛri kan, i don cogo kelen na ni jate kelen ye, ka o kode kɛ — a bɛ wari maralan, ani i ka jate, lasegin i n'a fɔ u tun bɛ cogo min na.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeSingle: Passkey da wulili kelen sɛbɛnnen bɛ nin jate ye dehub.io kan. Navigatɛri min b'a mara, dehub.io bɛ se ka nin wari maralan da wuli o la halibi.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeMultiple: Passkey da wulili caman sɛbɛnnen bɛ nin jate ye dehub.io kan. Navigatɛri min bɛ u la kelen mara, dehub.io bɛ se ka nin wari maralan da wuli o la halibi.
walletSetup.otherWaysCheckFailed: An ma se ka a lajɛ ni sira wɛrɛ b'i bolo ka segin nin wari maralan na. N'i ye laseginni kode walima passkey dɔ sigi dehub.io kan ka kɔrɔ, taa o lajɛ fɔlɔ — n'i taara ɲɛ yan, o bɛ u bɔsi.
walletSetup.loseFundsHead: Fɛn o fɛn bɛ wari maralan kɔrɔ kɔnɔ.
walletSetup.loseFundsBody: A ka wari bɛ to {{address}} la blockchain kan — foyi tɛ musaka wala ka ta — nka k'u lamaga, o wari maralan ka laseginni kuma walima a konnɛgɛ gundo de ka kan. N'o si t'i bolo, mɔgɔ si tɛ se k'u sɔrɔ: i yɛrɛ tɛ, an fana tɛ. Ni i tɛ se ka konnɛgɛ bɔ minɛn na min y'a dilan, a kɔnɔfɛnw jate i n'a fɔ u tununna.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryBody: Laseginni sɛbɛn min bɛ dehub.io kan, o bɛ bɔsi nin kɔnɔ, o la o sira fana bɛ datugu.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryUnknownBody: N'i ye laseginni kode daɲɛ 24 dɔ sigi dehub.io kan ka kɔrɔ, o bɛ bɔsi nin kɔnɔ. An ma se ka a lajɛ ni kelen b'i bolo.
walletSetup.losePasskeysBody: Passkey minnu sɛbɛnnen bɛ dehub.io kan, olu bɛ bɔsi nin kɔnɔ.
walletSetup.losePasskeysUnknownBody: Passkey o passkey sɛbɛnnen bɛ dehub.io kan, olu bɛ bɔsi nin kɔnɔ. An ma se ka a lajɛ ni dɔ b'i bolo.
walletSetup.keepAccountHead: I ka jate, a bɛ cogo min na tigitigi.
walletSetup.keepAccountBody: Tɔgɔ, profili, bila, hakilinaw, tugubagaw, badjiw ani tariku bɛɛ bɛ taa wari maralan kura kan. Jate kelen don — mɔgɔ si man kan ka i ɲini kokura.
walletSetup.keepMessagesHead: I ka cikanw ani i ka bataki sɔrɔyɔrɔ.
walletSetup.keepMessagesBody: Baro, kunnafoniw, taamasiyɛnw, bila maralenw ani filɛli tariku bɛ na i fɛ. Foyi tɛ jɔsi ani mɔgɔ wɛrɛ si tɛ se ka u la foyi kalan.

walletSetup.keepSignInBody: Telefɔni nimɔrɔ kelen, imɛli walima Google jate kelen, digili kelen kelen. Wari maralan min bɛ donni kɔ, o de bɛ falen, donni yɛrɛ tɛ.
walletSetup.checkDeviceHead: Minɛn min kan i y'a sigi, o lajɛ.
walletSetup.checkDeviceBody: Telefɔni bɛ konnɛgɛ kopi dɔ mara a yɛrɛ fɛ ni DeHub sigilen bɛ a kan, ani navigatɛri bɛ a ka passkey mara. N'u la kelen b'i bolo halibi, taa yen, konnɛgɛ gundo labɔ, ka segin ka Lasegin kɛ o nɔ na — o bɛ wari fana mara.

walletSetup.phraseInvalidHint: O tɛ laseginni kuma tilennen ye — daɲɛ 12, u jirala cogo min na o bolodacogo la, sɛbɛnni fitinin na bɛɛ.
walletSetup.privateKeyHint: Konnɛgɛ gundo ye hex sɛbɛnden 64 ye 0x kɔfɛ.
walletSetup.noUsableBackup: Wari maralan adrɛsi sɛbɛnnen bɛ nin jate ye, nka maracogo si t'a la nin telefɔni bɛ se ka min kɛ — a lakananna ni bolonɔ walima passkey ye web kan (o da wulili bɛ to navigatɛri kɔnɔ, a tɛ na yan), walima donni kɔrɔ dɔ nin telefɔni kan jɔra sani a ka ban.
walletSetup.addPasswordOnWeb: N'i ye dehub.io kɛ ka kɔrɔ, a da wuli i ka ɔridinatɛri kan, i don cogo kelen na ni jate kelen ye, ka wari maralan tɛmɛsira dɔ fara a kan — o bɛ maracogo dogolen dɔ mara nuwaji la. O kɔ, segin yan ka a lajɛ kokura.
walletSetup.deviceExplainer: O tɛ se ka sɛbɛri kɛ wala k'a hakili to a la. An b'a fɛ ka kuma 12 sɛbɛ ka bɔ a kɔnɔ. O le ye sira kelen ye ka segi ka bɔ a yɔrɔ wɛrɛ la, ka bɔ a yɔrɔ la, walima ka segi ka bɔ a yɔrɔ la. I ka tɛmɛsira sugandi ani i ka tɛmɛsira yɛrɛ lo b'o baara kɛ.
walletSetup.deviceExplainerSecuring: Foyi tɛ sɛbɛn walima ka hakili la — konnɛgɛ bɛ to nin minɛn kan. Walasa ka segin ka don ka bɔ minɛn wɛrɛ la, siti la, walima installation kura kɔfɛ, laseginni kuma daɲɛ 12 mara Labɛnw kɔnɔ waati wɛrɛ. Tɛmɛsira sugandi o nɔ na, o tuma tɛmɛsira yɛrɛ de bɛ o baara kɛ.

getting-started.title: Getting Started
getting-started.intro: DeHub sira duuru lo be yen ani u si t'a ɲini i fɛ i ka wari sɔrɔ: Google, Apple, code min cira i ka e-mail ma, code min cira sms fɛ, wala wari min be yen. O la, i be se ka fɛɛn bɛɛ ci, ka fɛɛn dɔ ci ani ka fɛɛn dɔ lajɛn i ma.

steps.1: Visit dehub.io - a ka dumuni kɛyɔrɔ ye a ka ɲɛfɛyɔrɔ ye, o la, i be se ka filɛli kɛ ka sɔrɔ ka don.
steps.2: I bena Google ni Apple ye, yɔrɔ minw na i be se ka e-mail wala telefɔni nimɔrɔ sɔrɔ, ani "Connect Wallet" yɔrɔ minw na i be yen.
steps.3: N'i be baara kɛ ni Google wala Apple ye, i ka baara kɛ ni a ye. N'i ye e-mail wala sms ci, i ka code min sɔrɔ, o don.
steps.4: O la, aw bena aw yɛrɛ tanga o ma. N'i ye i ka wari bila ɲɔgɔn na, o kɔrɔ ko i ka sɛbɛ dɔ kɛ min b'a yira ko i ye mɔgɔ dɔ ye.
steps.5: I ka mɔgɔ tɔgɔ sugandi. Mɔgɔw be min ye, o ye nin ye: i ka dehub.io/ <username> profile link.
steps.6: I ka dumuniw lajɛ, i ka kunnafoniw labɛn ani i ka sɛbɛw bila.

tips.1: Sosiyalisitiw, e-mailw ani smsw tɛ wari sara abada - DeHub b'o wari di. O la, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni wari ye min be se ka kɛ a ka wari ye.
tips.2: Yala i be se ka segi ka na ni a ye wa? I ka e-mail wala telefɔni nimɔrɔ sɛbɛn k'a yira ko i be se ka taga jamana wɛrɛ la.
tips.3: I be se ka kunnafoni caaman mara i ka baarakɛminan kelen kan ani k'u yɛlɛma ka kɛ i ka → ladɛrɛsi ye.

home-feed.title: Home Feed

steps.1: N'i b'a fɛ ka dumuni kɛ, i ka taga a filɛ.
steps.2: Ka tɛmɛ tabolow kan ka filɛri kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni kunnafoniw ye: soo (ALL), videwo, jaa, yɔrɔ, dɔnkilila, walima ɲanamanya.
steps.3: N'i b'a fɛ ka tɛmɛ o kan, i ka tɛmɛ o kan ka tɛmɛ o kan.
steps.4: N'i b'a fɛ ka dumuni yɛlɛma, i ka filɛri/farisogo tuguni (ka tɛmɛ dumuni kinibolo fɛ) kɛ k'a yɛlɛma: funteni, kura, walima sanfɛyɔrɔ.
steps.5: N'i be dumuni kɛ telefɔni na, i be se k'a to a be sumaya.
steps.6: N'i b'a fɛ ka tɛmɛ o kan, i ka tɛmɛ o kan ka tɛmɛ o kan.
steps.7: Ka fara o kan, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni miiriya ye min be se k'a to a be se ka fɛɛn dɔ ye min be se k'a bali ka fɛɛn dɔ ye.

tips.1: O ye fɛɛrɛ ɲuman ye ka ɲɛtaga kɛ ni fotow ye joona joona.
tips.2: O la, a be se ka kɛ ko a be fɛɛn bɛɛ ɲagami ɲɔgɔn na.
tips.3: O la, a ka di mɔgɔ caaman ye ka to ka to ka baro kɛ n'u ye.

home-feed.intro: I be mɔgɔ minw ka site webw filɛ ani u be taga ɲɛ, i be olu ka site webw filɛ. O be se ka kɛ sababu ye ka mɔgɔ caaman dɛmɛ u ka se ka baara kɛ ni u ka miiriya ye.

creating-posts.title: Ka baara kɛ ni barokunw ye
creating-posts.intro: I be se ka sɛbɛri kɛ, ka fotow, videwow, kumakanw, GIFw ani fɛɛn wɛrɛw di. I ka tagamasiɲɛw, tagamasiɲɛw ani tagamasiɲɛw kɛ walisa ka se ka mɔgɔ caaman dɛmɛ.

steps.1: O kɔ, aw ye "Post" tuguni digi a kan (desktop) wala "+" tuguni kan (mobile).
steps.2: I ka sɛbɛri kɛ yɔrɔ min na i be sɛbɛri kɛ.
steps.3: Walisa ka foto wala videwo dɔ fara a kan, aw ye sɛbɛn ɲɛ Kanpaɲi kan ani aw ye sɛbɛn ɲɛ Kanpaɲi kan.
steps.4: N'i b'a fɛ ka kumakan dɔ sɛbɛ, i ka mikrofɔni tagamasiɲɛ kan.
steps.5: N'i b'a fɛ ka GIF dɔ fara a kan, i ka GIF taamasiɲɛ lajɛ ka dɔ ɲini.
steps.6: Jɛnɛ ka #hashtags ɲɛma i ka sigi la (ka di #crypto, #defi).
steps.7: I ka $ cashtags kɛ ka tagamasiɲɛw kofɔ (i.e. $DHB, $ETH).
steps.8: N'i ye mɔgɔ dɔ weele ka na i ka site web kan, i ka kan k'a fɔ a ye ko: "I ye mɔgɔ dɔ weele ka na i ka site web kan".
steps.9: I ka ɲi ka "Siga" tuguni kan ka sɛbɛri kɛ. I ka barokun be sɔrɔ gafe nin kɔnɔ joona joona.

tips.1: O la, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni miiriya ɲuman ye.
tips.3: O kama, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni miiriya ɲuman ye.

interacting-with-posts.title: Ka baara kɛ ni barokunw ye

steps.1: N'i ye kunnafoni dɔ bila a kan, a to a ka kɛ i n'a fɔ a ye kunnafoni dɔ bila a kan.
steps.2: N'i b'a fɛ ka kuma dɔ fɔ, i ka kumaden nin lajɛ ani i ka jaabili dɔ bila a kan.
steps.3: N'i b'a fɛ ka tagamasiɲɛ dɔ ci a danbaga ma, i ka sɛbɛn ɲɛ GEM/TIP tagamasiɲɛ kan.
steps.4: I ka kan ka sɛbɛri kɛ ka sɔrɔ ka sɛbɛri kɛ.
steps.5: N'i b'a fɛ ka tɛmɛ o kan, i ka tɛmɛ o kan ka tɛmɛ o kan.
steps.6: I ka kan ka tɛmɛ o kan ka sɛbɛri kɛ i ka kaan na.
steps.7: Ni mɔgɔ dɔ ye foto dɔ ta, a ka ɲi ka "Traduction image" tuguni kɛ walisa ka kunnafoni wɛrɛ sɔrɔ min bayɛlɛmana ka kɛ AI ye.
steps.8: O la, i ka ɲi ka tɛmɛ fɛɛrɛ dɔw fɛ k'a yira ko i be se ka fɛɛn dɔ ye min be se ka mɔgɔ bali ka fɛɛn dɔ ye.

tips.1: O la, a tun be se ka kɛ ko a tun ye mɔgɔ dɔ ye min tun ye mɔgɔ dɔ ye.
tips.2: I be se ka wari dɔ sigi ni mansinw ye joona joona wala ka wari dɔ don i yɛrɛ la.
tips.3: O la, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni sɛbɛri ye min be se k'a dɛmɛ ka baara kɛ ni sɛbɛri ye.

explore-search.title: Ka ɲinini kɛ/ka ɲinini kɛ
explore-search.intro: I be se ka kunnafoni kuraw ni mɔgɔ kuraw sɔrɔ ɲinini ɲɛɛ kan ani ka ɲinini kɛ ni fanga ye.

steps.1: I be se ka taga yɔrɔ min na, i ka taga yɔrɔ min na, i ka taga yɔrɔ min na.
steps.2: I be se ka tɛmɛ barokun nin kan ka mɔgɔ, yɔrɔ wala kunnafoni ɲini.
steps.3: * Fɛɛn minw bɛɛ be sɔrɔ o la: bɛɛ, mɔgɔw, barokunw, fotow, videwow, dɔnkiliw, ɲɛnɛma.
steps.4: A filɛ yɔrɔ minw na mɔgɔw be taga bɔ yɔrɔ dɔw la.
steps.5: N'i b'a fɛ ka kunnafoni wɛrɛw sɔrɔ, i ka ɲi ka tɛmɛ o kan ka tɛmɛ o kan.
steps.6: N'i b'a fɛ ka mɔgɔ dɔ ka kunnafoniw sɔrɔ, i ka tɛmɛ a kan ka tɛmɛ a kan.

tips.1: Sɛgɛsɛgɛri be se ka mɔgɔ tɔgɔw, a ka wari sɔrɔyɔrɔw ani a ka kumaden jɔnjɔnw dɛmɛ.
tips.2: O kama, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni miiriya ɲuman ye.

profile.title: Mɔgɔ dɔw ka ɲɛyirali
profile.intro: I ka kunnafoniw be sɔrɔ i ka site web kan, i ka tuguɲɔgɔn, i ka tuguɲɔgɔn ani i ka wari sɔrɔyɔrɔ la.

steps.1: I ka avatar wala i ka "Profil" lajɛ barokun nin na walisa k'i ka kunnafoniw lajɛ.
steps.2: N'i b'a fɛ ka i tɔgɔ, i ka ɲɛnamaya ani i ka avatar lakunu, i ka "Edit profile" lajɛ.
steps.3: I ka sɛbɛri kɛ ka tɛmɛ i ka sɛbɛri kan ka sɛbɛri kɛ.
steps.4: I ka tuguɲɔgɔn filɛ ani i ka jatiminɛ kɛ i ka site web kan.
steps.5: I yɛrɛ ka barokunw, kunnafoniw ani i ka barokunw lajɛ i ka barokunw kɔnɔ.
steps.6: I ka sɛbɛri kɛ ka tɛmɛ o kan, i ka sɛbɛri kɛ ka tɛmɛ o kan.
steps.7: I be se ka tɛmɛ i ka site web kan ka tɛmɛ i ka site web kan.

tips.1: I tɔgɔ ye dan na ani a be sɔrɔ i ka URL kɔnɔ (dehub.io/ @username).
tips.2: I ka ladɛrɛsiw be se k'i dɛmɛ k'a lɔn mɔgɔ min be se k'i ka kalandenw jati.

messages.title: Kibaro diimanw
messages.intro: N'i ye mɔgɔ dɔ weele ka na i ka site web kan, i ka kan ka kuma n'a ye.

steps.1: N'i b'a fɛ ka tɛmɛ o kan, i ka tɛmɛ o kan ka tɛmɛ o kan.
steps.2: Kiliki i lalo i le faʻamau o le tusitusiga e amata ai se talanoaga fou.
steps.3: Saili se tagata faʻaaoga i le igoa faʻaaoga e faʻafesoʻotaʻi ai i latou.
steps.4: Tusi lau feʻau ma fetaomi atu i le lafoina.
steps.5: Vaʻai lau talaʻaga o talanoaga i le lisi o feʻau.
steps.6: Kiliki i luga o se talanoaga e faʻaauau ai le talanoa.

tips.1: O le a e mauaina se faʻasilasilaga pe a feʻau mai se tasi ia te oe.
tips.2: E mafai e le au foafoa ona loka feʻau i tua o se manaʻoga o le pito.

ai-assistant.title: AI Fesoasoani
ai-assistant.intro: Talanoa ma le AI fesoasoani a DeHub mo fesoasoani, faʻamatalaga, ma galuega faʻatino.

steps.1: Kiliki le 'Fesoasoani' i le itu itu e tatala ai le AI chat.
steps.2: Tusi lau fesili poʻo lau talosaga i le faʻamau o le chat.
steps.3: E mafai ona fesoasoani le AI i faʻamatalaga o le crypto, fesili i luga o le tulaga, ma le malamalama lautele.
steps.4: Amata se talanoaga fou e ala i le kilikiina o le faʻamau o le talanoaga fou.
steps.5: Vaʻai lau talaʻaga o talanoaga i le itu itu o le itulau fesoasoani.
steps.6: E mafai ona e faʻapipiʻi ata mo le AI e suʻesuʻe.

tips.1: E manatua e le AI le faʻatulagaina i totonu o se talanoaga.
tips.2: E mafai ona e fesili i le AI e uiga i foliga o DeHub, faʻamatalaga o le crypto, poʻo fesili lautele.
tips.3: O talanoaga ua tuanaʻi e teuina ma avanoa i soʻo se taimi.

notifications.title: Faʻasilasilaga
notifications.intro: Ia faʻafouina i le fiafia, faʻamatalaga, pito, mulimuli, ma isi gaioiga i luga o lau mea na fai.

steps.1: Kiliki le faʻailoga o le logo poʻo le 'Faʻasilasilaga' i le itu itu.
steps.2: Vaʻai uma faʻasilasilaga i se lisi faʻasologa.
steps.3: Kiliki i luga o se faʻasilasilaga e alu i le mea na fai.
steps.4: O faʻasilasilaga e aofia ai: tagata fou mulimuli, palota o pou, faʻamatalaga, pito, ma taʻua.
steps.5: O faʻasilasilaga e leʻi faitauina e faʻamalamalamaina - latou te faʻailogaina e pei o faitau pe a vaʻaia.

tips.1: O le faʻailoga faʻasilasilaga o loʻo faʻaalia ai le numera o faʻasilasilaga e leʻi faitauina.
tips.2: O faʻasilasilaga o pito e faʻaalia ai le tele o faʻailoga na e mauaina.

wallet.title: Taga Tupe
wallet.intro: Vaʻai lau DeHub token paleni i luga o filifili eseese, siaki tupe teu, ma pulea au meatotino.

steps.1: Kiliki le 'Taga Tupe' i le itu itu e tatala ai le itulau o le taga tupe.
steps.2: Aw ye aw ka siginidenw bɛɛ lajɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ.
steps.3: A filɛ, a be se ka kɛ ni jɔrɔkɔ kelen kelen bɛɛ ye: Ethereum, BASE, BNB jɔrɔkɔ ani dɔ wɛrɛw.
steps.4: I ka wari ni i ka sara lajɛ.
steps.5: N'i b'a fɛ ka wari sɔrɔ, i ka "Refresh Scan" lajɛ.
steps.6: I ka wari di mɔgɔ wɛrɛw ma walisa u ka wari di i ma.

tips.1: O la, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni miiriya ɲuman ye.
tips.2: O b'a yira ko a be se ka kɛ ni jii ye (a be se ka kɛ) ani a be se ka kɛ ni sumanikɛnan ye.

staking.title: Ka to ka to
staking.intro: I ka DeHub tagamasiɲɛw labɛn walisa ka sara sɔrɔ ani ka fanga di i ka gofɛrɛnɛman ma ka vote.

steps.1: I be se ka taga "Staking" ɲɛɛ kan barisa i be taga.
steps.2: I b'a fɛ ka taga yɔrɔ min na, i ka taga yen.
steps.3: Jula: Sɛɛlɛti sɛɛn tii wɛɛlɛ tii suta.
steps.4: I ka wari sɔrɔ i ka wari la (ka wari sɔrɔ i ka wari la) wala i ka baara kɛ i yɛrɛ ma (i ka sigida la).
steps.5: I ka wari ni i ka sara minw be yen, i ka miiri u la.
steps.6: Walisa k'o wari bɔ, i ka wari don ani k'a fɔ ko i ma wari min sara, i ma o wari bɔ.

tips.1: O la, u bena fanga sɔrɔ ka tɛmɛ u ka fanga kan.
tips.2: Mɔgɔ minw be tɛmɛ ɛntɛrɛnɛti kan, olu mako t'a la ka gazi sɔrɔ.
tips.3: I be se ka juru caaman don ɲɔgɔn na.

leaderboard.title: Ɲɛminɛbaga
leaderboard.intro: A filɛ jɔn lo be sanfɛ! O la, a ka ɲi ka tɛmɛ fɛɛrɛ dɔw fɛ k'a yira ko a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni miiriya ɲuman ye.

steps.1: N'i b'a fɛ ka tɛmɛ o kan, i ka tɛmɛ o kan ka tɛmɛ o kan.
steps.2: Tabw: balansi, loon o loon, ani dugu ka kuma.
steps.3: O la, a ka ɲi ka kɛ ni miiriya ɲuman ye.
steps.4: O la, mɔgɔ minw tun be baara kɛ ka tɛmɛ mɔgɔ tɔw bɛɛ kan, olu tun be to ka to ka baara kɛ ka tɛmɛ mɔgɔ tɔw bɛɛ kan.
steps.5: Dugu ka kuma b'a yira ko mɔgɔ caaman be koo minw faamu, u ka ca.
steps.6: N'i b'a fɛ ka mɔgɔ dɔ ka kunnafoniw sɔrɔ, i ka tɛmɛ a kan ka tɛmɛ a kan.

tips.1: Loon o loon, an ka ladɛrɛsiw be segi ka sigi sen kan lɛri 24 kɔnɔ.
tips.2: Talk of the City be kuma kelen kelen bɛɛ ka tagamasiɲɛw lo yira.

command-centre.title: Kɛlɛkɛyɔrɔ
command-centre.intro: O la, i bena a ye ko i ye mɔgɔ dɔ ye min be se k'i ka baara kɛ.

steps.1: I ka ɲi ka "Command Center" lajɛ barokun nin na.
steps.2: I ka kunnafoniw lajɛ, i ka lɛtɛrɛw, i ka kalandenw ani i ka laɲinitaw.
steps.3: I ka baara n'i ka kokɛcogow lajɛ.
steps.4: Ka tɛmɛ fɛɛrɛ dɔw fɛ, i be se ka tɛmɛ fɛɛrɛ dɔw fɛ ka tɛmɛ fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛw fɛ.

tips.1: O yɔrɔ la, i be se ka kɔnɔwye i ka DeHub ka yɔrɔ la.

governance.title: Governance

tips.1: I ye tagamasiyɛn minw sigi, o lo b'a to i be se ka vote.
tips.2: Badge holders may get additional vote weight.
tips.3: Proposals go through stages: Active → Passed/Rejected.

governance.intro: Ka kɛ sababu ye ka mɔgɔw dɛmɛ u ka se ka laɲinitaw dafa.

steps.1: Ka taga "Dugukolokura" yɔrɔ la, o kɔrɔ ko ka taga "Dugukolokura" yɔrɔ la.
steps.2: O kama, an ka ɲi k'an seko bɛɛ kɛ ka mɔgɔw dɛmɛ u ka se ka Jehova bato.
steps.3: N'i b'a fɛ ka kuma o koo la, i ka ɲi ka tɛmɛ o kan ka kuma o koo la.
steps.4: I ka vote ka kɛɲɛ ni DeHub ka tagamasiɲɛ hakɛ ye.
steps.5: A to i ka kuma dɔw fɔ walisa ka baro kɛ ni mɔgɔw ye.
steps.6: I yɛrɛ ka ladili di n'i ye "Dɔtɔrɔso la" tuguni kan.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.intro: I ka gafew bila yɔrɔ dɔw la walisa u ka se ka sɔrɔ kɔfɛ.

steps.1: I ka kan ka sɛbɛri kɛ ka sɔrɔ ka sɛbɛri kɛ.
steps.2: I ka taga "Bookmarks" yɔrɔ la barokɛyɔrɔ la walisa ka kunnafoniw bɛɛ lajɛ.
steps.3: I ka ɲi ka tɛmɛ o kan ka sɛbɛri kɛ.
steps.4: N'i ye tagamasiɲɛ dɔ bila a kan, i ka tagamasiɲɛ tagamasiɲɛ dɔ bila a kan.

tips.1: I ka sɛbɛw be se ka kɛ i yɛrɛ ka sɛbɛw ye.
tips.2: I be se ka baara minw kɛ, daan t'o la.

settings.title: Settings

steps.1: I ka ɲi ka "Siga" sɔrɔ barokun nin na.
steps.2: I ka kaan yɛlɛma ka bɔ kaan sugandili la.
steps.3: I ka laɲinitaw yɛlɛma: k'a filɛ i ka kalandenw be jatiminɛ kɛra cogo min na ani u be tugu i kɔ cogo min na.
steps.4: I ka laɲinitaw sigi sen kan.
steps.5: O kama, a ka ɲi ka tɛmɛ fɛɛrɛ dɔw fɛ k'a yira ko a ka

tips.1: DeHub be kaan caaman fɔ — a ka baara bɛɛ be bayɛlɛma.
tips.2: N'o tɛ, a ka ɲi ka to ka kuma n'a ye.

settings.intro: I ka DeHub ka lɔnniya yɛlɛma ni kaan, dan na ani i ka ɲɛnagwɛkow ye.

posting-allowance.title: I ka loon o loon wari hakɛ
posting-allowance.intro: I ka batɛmu fɛ, i be se ka wari caaman sɔrɔ loon o loon. U bɛɛ be daminɛ ni lɛtɛrɛ 10 ye ani videwo, fotow ani kumakanw be se ka kɛ gigabyte kelen ye tile kɔnɔ. ka tɛmɛ kelen kan ani o loon tɔɔ bɛɛ sara dehub tagamasiyɛnw dɔrɔn lo kan min be tɛmɛ

steps.1: O kama, a tun man nɔgɔ ka wari caaman sɔrɔ.
steps.2: O kama, n'i ye tile kelen kɛ ka videwo bila, i be se ka sɛbɛ tan bɛɛ bila a la.
steps.3: Ni baara dɔ be tɛmɛ, a ka ɲi ka kɔn ka wari di a ma ani k'a sɛgɛsɛgɛ k'a filɛ i ka wari be se k'a datugu sanni fɛɛn dɔ ka se ka yɛlɛ.
steps.4: O la, a ka ɲi ka wari caaman sɔrɔ ka sɔrɔ ka wari caaman sɔrɔ.

steps.6: Post owners kɛnɛ kɛnɛ visibility (Public, Unlisted, ni Private) ni edit title/description kɛnɛ page.

tips.1: A freshly minted post kɛnɛ creator kɛnɛ 1,000 fractions (100% ownership).
tips.2: Transaction hash kɛnɛ BaseScan ni BscScan kɛnɛ chain.

connect.title: DeHub jɛnsɛn i ka AI dɛmɛbaga la
connect.subtitle: ChatGPT walima Claude ka sira di DeHub ma — postiw lajɛ, kumaw ka jɔli kalan, ɲinini kɛ ani profiliw lajɛ — ni i ye URL min bɛ duguma ninnu nɔrɔ i ka dɛmɛbaga ka jɛnsɛnnan labɛnniw kɔnɔ.
connect.agentTitle: I b'a fɛ a ka post kɛ, ka kalata kɛ ani ka jaabi di wa?
connect.agentBody: URL min bɛ san fɛ, o ye kalan dɔrɔn de ye. Ajan dɔ dilan, i bɛ i yɛrɛ ka jɛnsɛnnan URL sɔrɔ min kɔnɔ kile bɛ — taabolo kelenw, nka dɛmɛbaga bɛ se ka post kɛ, ka kuma fɔ, ka kalata kɛ ani ka tugu i ka ajan ye.
connect.chatgptDevMode: Jɛnsɛnnan labɛnniw kɔnɔ, labɛnbaga cogoya lawuli (farati kunnafoni min bɛ yen, o kalan).
connect.chatgptComposer: Baro kɛsu ka "+" menu kɔnɔ, labɛnbaga cogoya lawuli.
connect.chatgptAddSources: Sɔrɔyɔrɔw fara a kan sugandi, o kɔ Jɛnsɛn caman wɛrɛw.
connect.nameAndPaste: Jɛnsɛnnan tɔgɔ da ko "DeHub" ani MCP URL min bɛ san fɛ, o nɔrɔ.
connect.askToUse: {{app}} ɲini a ka DeHub baara — misali la: "DeHub kan post minnu bɛ ka ta, olu yira n na."
connect.claudeEnable: Jɛnsɛnnan lawuli Claude ka baro kɛsu la, o kɔ a ɲini a ka DeHub baara.
connect.otherClients: Kiliyan wɛrɛ bɛɛ min bɛ bɛn MCP ma, o bɛ baara kɛ ten — MCP sɛriwɛri kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen fara a kan ani URL min bɛ san fɛ, o nɔrɔ.
connect.guideIntro: DeHub bɛ sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ {{app}} ka jɛnsɛnnan yɛrɛ. A lawuli siɲɛ kelen ani {{app}} ɲininka DeHub postiw, dabagaw ani taamasiyɛnw kan — baro kɔnɔ yɛrɛ.
connect.step1Body: Butɔn min bɛ san fɛ, o digi. {{app}} bɛ da wuli DeHub jɛnsɛnnan kan yɛrɛ Labɛnniw → Jɛnsɛnnanw kɔnɔ.
connect.step2Body: DeHub lawuli ani sira di. O kɔ {{app}} bɛ se ka DeHub ka post foroba, profiliw ani barokun minnu bɛ ka ta, olu kalan.
connect.step3Title: Baro kura daminɛ ani a baara
connect.step3Body: Baro kura da wuli ani DeHub tɔgɔ fɔ i ka ɲinini kɔnɔ — {{app}} bɛ jɛnsɛnnan wele a yɛrɛ ma.
connect.promptsToTry: Ɲininiw minnu bɛ se ka kɛ
connect.prompt1: DeHub kan post 10 minnu bɛ ka ta kosɛbɛ sisan, olu kuma surunya.
connect.prompt2: DeHub kan post minnu bɛ Bitcoin kan waati 24 laban kɔnɔ, olu ɲini ani kuma surun di n ma.
connect.prompt3: DeHub profili @satoshi lajɛ ani a ye min post nin dɔgɔkun in na, o fɔ n ye.
connect.faq: Ɲininkali minnu bɛ kɛ tuma caman
connect.faqFreeQ: DeHub ye fu ye {{app}} kɔnɔ wa?
connect.faqFreeA: Ɔwɔ. Jɛnsɛnnan ye fu ye. I ka {{app}} labɛnni ka kan ka jɛnsɛnnanw dɛmɛ.
connect.faqWhatQ: DeHub jɛnsɛnnan bɛ se ka mun kɛ?
connect.faqWhatA: MCP fɛ, a bɛ se ka DeHub ka post foroba lajɛ, ka barokunw ɲini ani ka dabagaw ka profiliw lajɛ. A tɛ post kɛ i tɔgɔ la.
connect.faqAccountQ: DeHub jatebɔsɛbɛn wajibiyalen don n ma wa?
connect.chatgptFaqAccount: O kama, a man kan ka kɛ ko mɔgɔ si tɛ se ka kunnafoni sɔrɔ a ka site web kan. DeHub ka kunnafoniw be se ka kɛ n'i b'a fɛ ka DeHub ka tagamasiɲɛw ci, k'u ci wala k'u mara.
connect.claudeFaqAccount: Ka mɔgɔw kalan, o be kɛ sababu ye u tɛ se ka wari sɔrɔ. I mako be DeHub ka kunnafoni dɔrɔn lo la walisa ka DeHub ka tagamasiɲɛw ci, k'u ci wala k'u mara.

accountDeletion.title: Kɔnti jɔsi
accountDeletion.description: I ka kɔnti ni i yɛrɛ ka kunnafoniw jɔsi pewu
accountDeletion.warning: Nin bɛ i ka DeHub profil, i ka sɛbɛnw, i ka hakilinaw, i ka cikanw ani i ka wariminɛn kopi maralen jɔsi pewu. I ka wariminɛn segincogo kunnafoniw mara, ka i ka nafolow bɛɛ bɔ a la fɔlɔ. Blockchain kan jago minnu bɛ bɛɛ ɲɛ na ani sariya ye sara sɛbɛn minnu wajibiya, olu tɛ se ka jɔsi. I ka profil bɛ dogo o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ; jɔsili bɛ ban tile 30 kɔnɔ. O tɛ se ka segin kɔ.
accountDeletion.receipt: I ka jɔsili ɲinini marala. I ka profil dogolen don, i ka kɔnti bɛna jɔsi pewu tile 30 kɔnɔ. Ni i donna, o tɛ nin ɲinini dabila.
accountDeletion.error: An ma se ka i ka jɔsili ɲinini ci. I ka kɔnti jɔsili ma sɛmɛntiya. Segi k'a lajɛ tugun.
accountDeletion.signIn: Don walasa ka i ka kɔnti jɔsi
accountDeletion.acknowledge: N ye n ka wariminɛn segincogo kunnafoniw mara, ani n y'a faamu ko jɔsili tɛ se ka segin kɔ.
